## Activity

This report covers activity at East City Eye Clinic during April 2026. The clinic completed 227 captures during the reporting period. This figure represents the recorded imaging activity for the month and provides the basis for the image-quality and grading measures below. Activity should continue to be recorded consistently so that any changes in service demand or operational performance can be identified through routine review.

## Image quality

Of the completed captures, 4 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 1.8. These cases could not proceed through the usual grading process. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk so they can be reviewed and addressed through the appropriate support arrangements. Clear recording of equipment concerns will assist with monitoring image quality at the clinic.

## Grading

There were 60 results graded referable during April 2026. The median grading lag was 2. This measure indicates the midpoint of the recorded wait for grading and should be considered alongside the volume of captures and the ungradable rate. The results provide a concise view of activity, image quality, and grading performance at East City Eye Clinic for the reporting period.
